subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT an Olympics Sport? (As of March, 2023)
solution:
The correct answer is **Cricket.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Cricket is not currently included in the Olympics, but it is scheduled to be included in the 2028 Summer Olympics in Los Angeles.
 
• The LA28 Organizing Committee has proposed including cricket in the **2028 games as one of five additional sports.**
 
• Cricket was originally scheduled to be included in the** 1896 Athens Olympics**, but was later removed due to a lack of entries.
 
• It was included in the **1900 Paris Olympics**, where Great Britain won the 12-a-side match over France.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **3×3 Basketball** made its Olympic debut at the **Tokyo 2020 Games**, highlighting the evolution of Olympic sports to include new formats.
 
• **Rowing** has been a part of the modern Olympics **since 1900**, showcasing a long history in the Games.
 
• The latest games included in the Olympics are **breaking, skateboarding, sport climbing, and surfing**, featured in the **2024 Paris Olympic** Games.
 
• The International Olympic Council(IOC) also **proposed ski mountaineering** as a new winter sport for the 2026 Winter Olympics in Milano Cortina. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **International Olympic Committee**

 
 
• The IOC was founded on **June 23, 1894, by Pierre de Coubertin in Paris, France.**
 
• The IOC is headquartered in **Lausanne, Switzerland.**
 
• The IOC’s mission is to promote the Olympic Movement, which aims to contribute to building a peaceful and better world through sport.
 
• The IOC is responsible for organizing the **Summer and Winter Olympic Games**, held every four years for each, with the Games alternating every two years.
